title: Red Room Contemplation
description: A man with short hair sits on the floor of a cluttered, derelict room with his back to the viewer, holding an object to his face. The space is bathed in intense red light with a large plastic water jug glowing beside him, surrounded by scattered debris, open doorways, and a large wooden beam overhead.
prompt: A lone man sits on the floor of a messy abandoned room seen from behind, short dark hair, one hand raised to his face. The decaying interior is dramatically lit by intense red and pink light coming from the right, illuminating a large transparent plastic water jug that glows with red liquid. Scattered trash, bottles, open doorways leading to other rooms, wooden ceiling beam, hazy atmosphere, painterly digital art style.
